metadata.title: Governance DRep Discovery Plan Tasks
metadata.description: DRep Discovery + Wallet Current Vote Display, organized as a vertical-slice plan. Each slice is a thin end-to-end capability — minimum main-process/backend + IPC + store + UI, demoable behind the REAL IPC path, with its own Storybook + Jest + i18n landed in the same slice. There is no terminal i18n phase, no terminal test phase, and no pure-backend phase. Three sequential foundation slices close the browse -> select -> delegate journey for both wallet types: slice-1 (walking skeleton + log/analytics sanitization floor), slice-2 (software-wallet delegate), and slice-3 (hardware-wallet delegate). Three parallelizable tracks then thicken the product: Track D (discovery: detail -> cohort+badges+banner -> search/show-all -> favorites -> refresh+selfnode+release-verification), Track V (current vote: plumbing+core -> enrichment), and Track A (anchor: hardened-fetch+givenName -> completion). Two floors are never thinned across slices: the log/analytics sanitization invariant (lands in slice-1, asserted by every later slice) and the anchor transport security guards (land complete in anchor-1). Product content includes: BMVG citation, four-category badge, default-cohort-as-Recommended, 6-epoch drepActivity floor, CurrentVoteSummary live status badge, CIP-119 givenName + anchor links. All newly introduced en-US and ja-JP copy remains preliminary with a leading !!! until the final manual review at the end of the feature cycle. The slice-1 final pass (defect fixes) is tracked separately in task-plans/slice-1-final-pass-sprint.yaml. 2026-06-15 final-pass status refresh (FP-5): task-103 (query service) moved partial -> complete after FP-1 added the cardano-cli network flag and FP-9 renamed the DRep status literal to the ledger-correct active/inactive; the only residual limitation is the design constraint that drep-state exposes just expiry. slice-1 auditSummary.statusCounts updated to complete 8 / partial 0 / verified 3, and task-103/task-104/task-107 statusReason text was confirmed accurate and refreshed. 2026-06-15 final-pass bookkeeping (FP-6): the dead per-task origin property (legacy task numbers no tooling reads) was removed from all task entries and stale split/dissolved/hour-split parentheticals were cleaned from task descriptions; the original task lineage is preserved in git history. 2026-06-16 slice-1 closeout (Next Steps reconciliation): the disposable Next Steps section of task-plans/slice-1-final-pass-review.md was removed after confirming items 1-5 are already tracked across the tasking and PRDs; its only residual not previously in the tasking — the optional CLI-robustness cleanups (conway era-retry structured signal + real-binary argv smoke test) distilled from the slice-1 final-pass standing risks — was folded in as task-169 (ux-refinement phase, low priority). 2026-07-27 status vocabulary conformance: task-158 (the standing cardano-wallet API surface guardrail) moved from the unlisted status ongoing to pending, which predated statusVocabulary and was never a deliberate eighth term. pending is the accurate point-in-time value because the per-bump checklist and its swagger-grep artifact under tests/mocks/governance/ have not been produced yet; the recurrence of the guardrail is carried by the standing phase description and the README working conventions rather than by a status term.

tasks.title: Add main-process DRep query service
tasks.description: Implement the slice-1 singleton GovernanceQueryService in source/main/ for the DRep list query using the confirmed cardano-cli path and shared DRep Discovery types. The broader detail, vote-position, and wallet-governance-status surfaces are deferred to their later owning slices (slice-4 detail, Track V, Track A).
tasks.statusReason: Singleton service is wired from CardanoNode with selfnode/non-selfnode modes and a reset() boundary. Parser consumes real CLI tuple output (`[[credential, state], ...]`), derives CIP-129 DRep IDs from credential hashes via Cardano.DRepID.cip129FromCredential, requires an integer epoch scalar from `query tip`, retries with `conway` when the installed CLI rejects the `latest` era alias, and rejects partial anchors or non-string anchor fields instead of emitting broken placeholder data. Voting power is nullable when `--include-stake` returns no stake. 10 s CLI_TIMEOUT_MS budget emits Timeout. Both slice-1 final-pass follow-ups that previously held this task at partial are fixed this sprint: FP-1 added the required network flag (`--mainnet` / `--testnet-magic <N>`) to the CLI argv after the subcommand, so live queries no longer fail with the "Missing: (--mainnet | --testnet-magic NATURAL)" CLI error; FP-9 renamed the status literal to the ledger-correct `active | inactive` (derived from `expiry <= currentEpoch`), aligning with shared-design-tokens §1 and the downstream slice-5 Threshold / cv-2 status badges. Focused Jest coverage (26 tests passing) validates: tuple parsing, era fallback, raw oversized-lovelace preservation through `json-bigint`, strict tip parsing, strict scalar validation for tip/expiry/anchor fields, parse failures, timeout, CliNotFound, cache reset, dedup, and the network flag in spawn argv for both mainnet and testnet clusters. Representative drep-state / drep-stake-distribution / gov-state fixtures (including a lovelace value above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) are committed under tests/mocks/governance/. Moved to complete: the only remaining limitation is a known design constraint, not unfinished work — the ledger's drep-state output exposes just `expiry`, so the parser can ground only the two `active`/`inactive` states; `expiring` is intentionally a renderer-derived display state and `retired` is deferred until a distinct unregistration signal exists. Live synced-node confirmation that the UTxO-HD backend serves drep-state from in-memory ledger tables remains a manual release-verification item (FP-8 / FP-11), not implementation work.
acceptanceCriteria: Representative `drep-state`, `drep-stake-distribution`, and `gov-state` fixtures from a synced node are committed under tests/mocks/governance/ before this service merges, including at least one lovelace value above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
Requests latest local state on load and on user refresh, deduplicating in-flight requests and retaining last-successful data only for stale-while-refresh continuity.
Bulk `--all-dreps` is invoked once per latest-state refresh; per-DRep CLI invocations are forbidden.
Reads the captured node socket path from CardanoNode and passes it through `CARDANO_NODE_SOCKET_PATH` in spawn env.
Parses CLI stdout with json-bigint in lossless mode and constructs BigNumber values from raw decimal strings; native JSON.parse -> Number -> BigNumber is forbidden.
Includes a fixture/test with lovelace greater than 9_007_199_254_740_991 that round-trips parse -> IPC decimal string -> BigNumber rehydration losslessly.

Slice-1 remains list-only: per-id DRep validation, `InvalidDrepId`, ranking-unavailable error surfaces, and `gov-state` / proposal-vote-position behavior are deferred to the later slices that introduce those queries.

tasks.title: Redact governance vote targets in filterLogData
tasks.description: Use the existing omit-deep-lodash invocation pattern in filterLogData — flat key list, no path-aware visitor. Add keys dRepId, vote, voting (the existing helper recurses by key name at any depth, which already covers delegation.active.voting, delegation.next[*].voting, certificates[*].vote, etc.). This is part of the slice-1 sanitization floor that every later slice inherits.
tasks.statusReason: filterLogData now recursively redacts governance vote keys including nested array elements, and focused Jest coverage plus logger-boundary assertions verify the inherited sanitization floor. AC-1 holds (source/common/utils/logging.ts:45-48 carries drepId / dRepId / vote / voting in the omit-deep-lodash key list) and AC-3 holds (non-governance log shapes are unchanged, redact being purely constructive at logging.ts:51-71). AC-2 was the criterion that failed on the 2026-07-27 re-read and forced the demotion from verified to complete: filterLogData redacts only where a call site invokes it, and source/renderer/app/api/api.ts:379-383 logged the whole `wallets` and `legacyWallets` arrays with only `hwLocalData` passed through the helper; task-128 had put `voting?: WalletVotingTarget` on both delegation shapes (source/renderer/app/api/wallets/types.ts:117 and :123) and WalletsStore polls that endpoint on a 5000 ms interval (source/renderer/app/stores/WalletsStore.ts:69 and :264), so for any wallet that had voted a raw DRep id reached the log file roughly every five seconds — not merely during a delegation flow. RE-PROMOTED TO VERIFIED on 2026-07-28: task-170 (cv-1) landed and closed exactly that gap. It wraps six Shelley AdaWallet-shaped logger.debug success sites in filterLogData (post-change anchors api.ts:379 getWallets, :457 getWallet, :867 createWallet, :1583 restoreWallet, :1621 createHardwareWallet, :2071 updateWallet) and adds the dedicated proof this row lacked: the getWallets call-boundary case 'redacts the vote target from the AdaApi wallet-list poll log' in tests/jest/security/governance-sanitization.spec.ts, which drives a real AdaApi.getWallets() over a voting-DRep fixture and asserts the emitted payload carries no CIP-129/CIP-105 string and no abstain / no_confidence literal. That case is proof BEYOND this row's own unit tests — it exercises a different module at a call boundary this row never touched — and it was shown to bite rather than pass vacuously: reverting only the getWallets wrap to its pre-task-170 form failed exactly that one case of 24 and named the fixture DRep id in the failure output, and restoring it returned the suite to 24 of 24 at exit 0. Whole-tree jest at that delivery was exit 0 at 86 suites (1 skipped / 85 passed) and 1073 tests (12 skipped / 1061 passed), yarn compile exit 0 and yarn lint exit 0 at exactly 5591 warnings with zero delta. Residual scope note, not an AC-2 gap: the renderer-side domain-object shape (votingTarget / currentVote and their identity members) is still absent from the wire-keyed sensitiveData list — recorded as F-15 in research/cv-1-findings.md and owned by the first cv-2 consumer — and the HardwareWalletsStore [HW-DEBUG] raw { error } sink is a substring-in-message class that key-based filterLogData structurally cannot reach. Neither is a call site this row's criteria cover.

tasks.title: Establish the sanitization regression spy floor
tasks.description: Jest test using spies over logger and the injected AnalyticsTracker.sendEvent (and optionally MatomoClient.sendEvent for integration-level coverage) asserting that no DRep id, no 'abstain' / 'no_confidence' literal, and no CIP-129/CIP-105 string appears in any logger.* payload or analytics call args. This establishes the sanitization floor asserted by every later slice.
tasks.statusReason: The governance sanitization spec now spies on both logger and AnalyticsTracker call boundaries to enforce the inherited no-leak floor for DRep ids and vote literals. Stays verified: AC-1 to AC-3 are about the spy harness existing, spying on the injected AnalyticsTracker.sendEvent, and being reusable by later slices, and all three still hold. The caveat recorded alongside the task-109 correction — that the suite's call-boundary cases covered delegateVotes and the two hardware-wallet paths only, with no getWallets case, leaving the spy floor short of the wallet-list poll path that source/renderer/app/api/api.ts:379-383 left unfiltered — is CLEARED as of 2026-07-28. task-170 AC-4 added that case: 'redacts the vote target from the AdaApi wallet-list poll log', which module-mocks getWallets over the voting-DRep fixture and getLegacyWallets over an empty array, drives a real AdaApi.getWallets(), and asserts the emitted 'AdaApi::getWallets success' payload contains no CIP-129/CIP-105 bech32 string and neither vote sentinel. The suite went 23 to 24 tests, exit 0, and the new case was proved non-vacuous by a probe that reverted only the getWallets wrap and failed exactly that one case of 24. The harness pattern this row established was reused unchanged — module-scope jest.mock factories that may require but must not close over a module-scope const — which is AC-3's reusability clause holding a fourth time. Remaining known gaps are outside this row's criteria and are recorded elsewhere rather than as caveats here: the domain-object shape (votingTarget / currentVote) is unredacted because sensitiveData is wire-keyed (F-15, owned by the first cv-2 consumer), and the HardwareWalletsStore [HW-DEBUG] raw { error } sink is a substring-in-message class no key-based redactor can reach.
acceptanceCriteria: Spies confirm zero leaks for DRep id, abstain, no_confidence, drep1/drep_vkh1/drep_script1 prefixes.
Spy is on the injected `AnalyticsTracker.sendEvent` (or equivalent renderer-facing tracker) — NOT on a non-existent `analytics.track` symbol.

tasks.title: Harden GovernanceQueryService CLI robustness (era-retry signal + real-binary argv smoke test)
tasks.description: Optional cleanup distilled from the slice-1 final-pass standing risks (carried over when the slice-1-final-pass-review.md Next Steps section was removed at slice-1 closeout). PART A - era-retry signal: replace the substring-based conway fallback gate in GovernanceQueryService._shouldRetryWithConway, which currently fires when the free-text error message/stderr contains the literal 'latest' plus an era-ish keyword (invalid|unknown|expected|expecting|conway|era). That couples the retry decision to incidental cardano-cli wording and to the implicit constraint that every other error string avoid the word 'latest' (see the deliberately reworded 'network not set' message). Gate the fallback on a structured signal instead (e.g. exit-code/error-class, or a one-time supported-era probe) so an unrelated QueryFailed can never trigger a spurious conway retry that masks the real error and burns a CLI timeout. PART B - real-binary argv smoke test: the unit suite mocks spawn and can only confirm the argv matches the developer's belief about cardano-cli grammar (the FP-1 prepend-vs-append regression class is structurally unclosable at the unit level). Add a parse-only smoke test that runs the bundled cardano-cli with the exact argv the service builds (era token + appended --mainnet / --testnet-magic <N>) WITHOUT CARDANO_NODE_SOCKET_PATH and asserts it passes the argument parser - failing only on a socket/connection error, never on a parse error (Invalid option / 'Missing: (--mainnet | --testnet-magic NATURAL)' / unknown era). Gated to environments where the real cardano-cli is on PATH (Nix shell). If task-161 lands first, apply the structured era-retry signal to both phase calls.
